title: Testing Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for Testing Engineers!

Qualifications

  • Identify and report data defects for tag auditing.
  • Perform end-to-end testing and release of website/mobile app deliverables with high quality.
  • Understand client requirements related to tag validation from both technical and end-user perspectives.
  • Understand the process and underlying implementation of tags.
  • Design and execute test scenarios using tag debugging tools to verify the quality of new curated data sets.
  • Maintain and enhance existing data verification techniques.
  • Collaborate with implementation engineers to integrate automation testing into the data curation pipeline.
  • Monitor and document post-implementation issues and revision requests to meet end-user needs.
  • Complete tasks and deliverables within scheduled time constraints.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • High attention to detail and commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively in a collaborative team environment
  • Adaptable to changing business requirements and evolving technologies

(*Note: Scoutit is an independent candidate sourcing partner for this hiring. All applications, candidate screening, and hiring-related actions are conducted directly by the respective employer’s authorized recruitment team. Relevant candidates will be contacted via email and asked to fill in additional details as part of the next stage of the application process.)
